criteria.sufficiency: E1 observes the configured human decision and proves authorization is unavailable unless the complete current pre-semantic exhausted-evidence predicate holds.
E1 checks every host-derived binding category and the behavioral mismatch/staleness matrix against the real decision surface.
E1 requires non-empty reason and defects and verifies that the recorded operational failure class remains unchanged.
E1 compares transition history before and after authorization and requires no allocation, semantic attempt, evaluator result, verdict, or verification-finalized fact.
E1 resolves implementation only after the exact authorization and confirms ordinary evaluator and implementation-correction predicates are unchanged.
E1 validates the named contract input, its authorization identity binding, and assignment exposure of the immutable public evidence without evaluator-private content.
E1 verifies successful handoff consumption plus replay, different-candidate, different-intent, and drift refusal.

E2 runs the public regression suite on the candidate and on the pre-candidate baseline in the same environment and reviews the real-surface cases showing failed/interrupted executions retain bounded retry authority and successful handoff returns to ordinary downstream resolution; environment-only failures shared with the baseline are not candidate evidence.
E1 checks the explicit-decision gate while E2's differential regression run and review exercise authentication, quota, provider, and infrastructure classifications without automatic correction.

The differential E2 comparison against the pre-candidate baseline shows no new failure across the unchanged evaluator, repair, correction, acceptance, promotion, As-Built, and Outcome paths, with scoped review.
E2 combines the differential regression result with a scoped candidate diff review that requires methodology-only changes or a documented minimal runtime enforcement gap.

E4 checks, at candidate verification and from the verifier's own host-issued assignment and the exact candidate commit, that the trusted sequence-6 methodology governs the verdict and that candidate sequence 7 neither adopts nor governs itself; it requires no closeout, acceptance, adoption, or cutover.

E3 post-acceptance review checks the explicit adoption's exact predecessor, candidate, PASS, closeout, and As-Built bindings and the single forward-only sequence-7 append; adoption cannot precede the candidate PASS.

E3 post-acceptance review checks host restart and a fresh ordinary grant over preserved Spike 014l history, including sequence pinning and the exact next authorized action without executing correction; cutover cannot precede adoption.
